confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from a few web searches. Those sources were mostly single-venue menus, crowd-sourced estimate pages and some dated material, so no citywide average was verified. Resort and theme-park prices were excluded or discounted, since they run well above off-property prices. Beer, cocktail and wine anchors are the least certain, and cocktail and wine values were cross-checked against bar and happy-hour ranges. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Orlando tourism context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, and no accommodation searches were run. Hostel anchors are especially uncertain because Orlando has few registered hostels.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a US mid-sized leisure city with high tourist demand and off-resort restaurant prices, benchmarked against typical North American tourism cities rather than a single specific comparable city.
